A '''stun club''' was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] that could stun an opponent.

[[Pacnorval Defense Systems, Limited]]'s [[Sg-82 sonic rifle]] incorporated a stun club into its design. Located on the weapon's handle on the other end from the [[Dispersal Dish]] and [[sound emitter]], the club's electrical charge was powered by the sonic rifle's standard [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]].<ref name="EGWT" />
